title: Financial Services & Data, Operational Risk Director
description: Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. The Director, Data Regulatory Compliance & Risk supports Experian's Financial Services and Data business within the North America Data Office. You will lead risk, regulatory compliance, and data privacy efforts to help the business meet applicable federal and state requirements and industry guidelines. The Director partners with Compliance, Audit, Legal, Product, Sales, and other North America teams to strengthen governance and support compliant products and cross-business initiatives. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. You will report to the SVP, Data Governance and and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Schaumberg, IL; Atlanta, GA. You will have opportunity to: Lead risk management and regulatory compliance programs across the Financial Services and Data department. Partner with Product and Sales teams to develop products and services that meet regulatory requirements. Develop compliance policies, procedures, standards, and employee training programs. Establish processes to identify, assess, monitor, and report compliance risks. Develop corrective action plans to address compliance issues and reduce operational risk. Advise our teams and clients on regulatory compliance, data privacy, and privacy impact assessments. Collaborate with Legal, Audit, Compliance, and other departments on shared regulatory and governance programs. Lead a team responsible for supporting risk management and compliance activities. 8+ years of experience in compliance and risk management. 3+ years of experience in data privacy. Experience applying federal and state laws and regulations relevant to financial services, consumer data, and privacy. Working knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA), Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) requirements, Federal Trade Commission (FTC) requirements, Federal Communications Commission (FCC) requirements, Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Experience developing compliance or audit reports for governing bodies, legal entities, or external authorities. Experience developing or maintaining compliance policies, procedures, standards, or corrective action plans. Experience advising business teams on regulatory compliance, data privacy, or privacy impact assessments. Experience leading, coaching, or developing employees. Benefits/Perks: Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity. Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. Benefits/Perks: Great compensation package and bonus plan Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://myexperianbenefits.com/ Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @ experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers . #LI-Hybrid

title: Lead, Capital Markets Risk
description: About Pagaya Shape the Future of Finance Pagaya is building a leading artificial intelligence network to help our partners grow their businesses and better serve their customers. Pagaya is a global technology company making life-changing financial products and services available to more people nationwide, as it reshapes the financial services ecosystem. By using machine learning, a vast data network and a sophisticated AI-driven approach, Pagaya provides comprehensive consumer credit and residential real estate solutions for its partners, their customers, and investors. Its proprietary API and capital solutions integrate into its network of partners to deliver seamless user experiences and greater access to the mainstream economy. Pagaya has offices in New York and Tel Aviv. For more information, visit  pagaya.com . Let's create better outcomes together! About the Role We’re looking to add a Capital Markets Risk Lead as an integral part of the Enterprise Risk Management team, providing oversight and analytical review of Pagaya’s investment vehicles, counterparties, and overall market risks. Ideally, you come from a debt capital markets team or a fintech that executes securitizations , and possess a strong background in Debt ABS . A deep, fundamental understanding of consumer credit is critical for success in this role. Responsibilities Assess performance of Pagaya’s financing vehicles (e.g., securitizations and forward flow arrangements), conducting attribution analyses, ongoing monitoring, and independent valuations Conduct market analyses and peer benchmarking, understanding broader credit industry trends as well as those of our lending partners Provide second line oversight of liquidity, funding, and risk retention decisions, as well as related performance triggers and covenants Liaise across Portfolio Management, Research, and Finance teams to understand and mitigate relevant risks Evaluate the financial viability, creditworthiness, and operational health of third parties (e.g., lending partners, servicers, and other counterparties) Support coordination of inbound and outbound due diligence requests across lending partners Maintain, develop, and prepare executive-level reporting on the above items through various ongoing forums and committees Requirements Undergraduate degree majoring in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or Engineering with a minimum of 8 years of experience in a consumer finance/lending institution Demonstrated experience in Credit Risk, Debt ABS (Asset-Backed Securities) , and Counterparty Risk management, with knowledge of relevant regulations and standards Experience working on a debt capital markets team or at a fintech involved in securitizations is highly preferred Fundamental consumer credit knowledge is super important Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Power Point, and related Google suite tools, with ability to work with various data sources and tools. High degree of comfort preparing executive-level materials is a must Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to persuasively communicate complex issues and outstanding attention to detail Ability to independently analyze problems and formulate recommendations/conclusions Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a complex and dynamic environment CFA, FRM, MBA and/or other advanced credentials are a plus Familiarity with Intex and dv01 is a plus The pay ranges for New York-based hires are commensurate with candidate experience.  Pay ranges for candidates working in locations other than New York may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. Compensation Range for New York Based Hires $130,000 — $160,000 USD Our Team Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.  We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community. Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers. Our Values Continuously Learn - We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners. Debate and Commit - We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together. Dream Big and Act - We boldly tackle complex problems, pressure-test solutions in real-time, and adapt with speed and energy. Advance Inclusion - We create a world where everyone can win, designing systems that better represent people and generate sustainable value for our employees, partners and investors. title: Senior Director, Solutions Engineering
description: Help the world move AI. At Kong, we're building the connectivity layer that brings AI, APIs, and applications together. Our work helps organizations innovate faster, more securely, and more efficiently. We're looking for people who think boldly, lead with purpose, and want to make an impact. If you're ready to take on meaningful challenges, do work that matters, and help build what comes next for technology, we'd love to meet you. The Mission: We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong , we aren’t just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands. Our customers are deciding how APIs, LLM traffic, and AI agents will be connected and governed across their companies, and the technical story has to be right every time. As Senior Director of Solutions Engineering, you lead the organization that makes it so. The Role: Strategy & Scale: We are looking for a visionary, operationally rigorous, and developmental Senior Director of Solutions Engineering to lead our pre-sales Solutions Engineering organization in the Americas. You are a leader of leaders: Solutions Engineering Managers report to you, and you lead the organization through them. You will set the technical go-to-market strategy for the team and partner with the VP of Americas Sales, CRO and sales leadership to drive pipeline, technical win rate, and revenue. At Kong, we are masters of our craft. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution. If you have built and scaled a world-class SE organization, and you want to define how the biggest companies in the world adopt API and AI connectivity, you’ve found your next home. What You Will Achieve: Own the SE Strategy: Define the Solutions Engineering coverage model, specialization, and ratios that align technical resources to segments, territories, and the pipeline. Lead Leaders: Hire, coach, and develop Solutions Engineering Managers, and build a bench of future leaders ready for their next role at Kong. Win Together with Sales: Partner with the CRO, VP Americas, Regional Vice Presidents, and Regional Directors on pipeline, forecast, and strategic deals, and build your own relationships with CTOs, CISOs, Chief Architects, and other executives at the Global 2000. Lead the AI Conversation: Ensure the organization leads Kong’s API Management and AI governance motion, from API and AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to demonstrations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection. Scale Enablement: Build onboarding, certification, and repeatable technical assets that make every Solutions Engineer effective faster, and drive thought leadership through blogs, webinars, and industry events such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, and API & AI Summit. Shape the Product: Be the field’s strongest voice to product and engineering, turning customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the roadmap. Operate with Rigor: Own headcount planning, hiring, performance, and the metrics that matter, such as POC conversion and technical win rate. What You Bring to the Journey: A Track Record of Excellence: 12+ years of solutions engineering, software engineering, or technical sales leadership experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company, including 5+ years leading managers or other leaders of Solutions Engineers. Leadership Depth: You have hired, developed, and promoted SE leaders, and you can name the ones you’ve built. Sales Partnership: You have a record of working side by side with sales leadership to improve technical win rate, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy on complex, enterprise-level deals. Technical Credibility: Deep familiarity with cloud-native platforms, REST and GraphQL APIs, API security patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC, and mTLS, and AI and LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance, plus familiarity with MCP and agentic AI patterns. Operational Discipline: You run a rigorous cadence for planning, hiring, performance, and reporting, and you are comfortable with budgets and headcount models. Executive Presence: You are a compelling communicator who earns trust with C-level executives and with the leaders who report to you. Why You’ll Thrive at Kong: Category-Defining Technology: Work with a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to succeed in an AI-first world. Scope and Influence: You will shape the technical go-to-market strategy for the Americas alongside the CRO and senior sales leadership. Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there. Inclusive Excellence: We offer comprehensive health coverage, equity, flexible PTO, and a culture where diverse perspectives are the fuel for our innovation. #LI-MP1 About Kong: Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com .
